page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at top left of the column. Page number at top right, outside the column. No marginal notes, footnotes or catchword. Left edge of the neighbouring page is not transcribed.

main_text.p: ob Regis legitimè constituti sævitiam, aliosve mores tyrannicos, de eo abdicando, vel interficiendo conjurat, perindè facit ac filius, qui dum justa de causa cædıtur, virgam vi eripit, & extorquet è manu patris, atque in frusta concidit, vel cremat ignibus; quo facto, parentis in se animum, non ad misericor-diam, sed ad iracundiam commovet, facitque, ut qui virgas fregit, mox loris vel funibus Ibericis feriatur, & tamdiu vapulet, dum rectam placandi rationem invenerit, nempè, eum lachrymis, obsecratione, precibus, & culpæ deprecatione ad miserationem flexerit.
main_text.head: CAP. VII.
De admirabili Davidis erga Saulem obe-dientia.
main_text.p: CUm jam ex voto suo Israelitæ Sau-lem sibi Regem elegissent, ille sibi suisque posteris duplici inprimis peccato dominandi ansam præripuit. Primò, quod Samuelem in officio sacerdotis præveniisset, ipseque suis manibus Deo obtulisset

page.notes: Faint ghost text in the right margin and show-through from the reverse side were left out. The left-hand fragment belongs to the neighbouring page. Doubtful readings: "eum lachrymis" (possibly "cum"), "miserationem" (no macron visible). The drop cap "C" is shown in italic in the paragraph and may be a woodcut initial; the first word is read as "CUm". The title "obedientia" is hyphenated at the line end as "obe-dientia".
